integrity: All mathematical assertions in the package are proved directly from the cited definitions. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The separation is proved for Nishimura's unrestricted closure semantics. The construction uses a constant closure and does not establish a finite counterexample under the additional identity-closure, monotonicity, extensivity, or idempotence restrictions.
title: A one-world finite separation of \(\mathsf{GK}\) from Kripke representability
